name: Databricks
description: Connector for the Databricks SQL warehouse / Lakehouse as a batch source and destination. DB-API via databricks-sql-connector. Optimized reads (keyset/offset pagination) and optimized writes (batched multi-row INSERT; flag-gated COPY-INTO from cloud storage is dormant in v1.0.0). Native Delta MERGE upsert present but dormant.

supported_versions.batch: Databricks SQL warehouses (Unity Catalog); DBSQL / Delta

supported_auth_methods.description: Personal Access Token (PAT) over a SQL warehouse (server_hostname + http_path).

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog (defaults to the warehouse's default catalog)

connect_timeout.description: Socket timeout and max retry duration (seconds) for opening a connection; bounds the driver's retry policy so an unreachable host fails fast instead of retrying ~15 min

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog (defaults to the warehouse's default catalog)

connect_timeout.description: Socket timeout and max retry duration (seconds) for opening a connection; bounds the driver's retry policy so an unreachable host fails fast instead of retrying ~15 min

load_strategy.notes: Default bulk write is a batched multi-row INSERT. Flag-gated COPY-INTO from cloud storage (RSYNC_DATABRICKS_COPY_INTO) is dormant in v1.0.0 and falls back to multi-row INSERT. Upsert is a native single Delta MERGE INTO.
